cap: Each drug matches a slide. Fluconazole treats candidiasis, which shows yeast and pseudohyphae on a KOH prep, by inhibiting lanosterol 14-alpha-demethylase, a fungal cytochrome P450 enzyme needed for ergosterol, and partners are not treated. Metronidazole is a prodrug reduced into DNA-damaging radicals only in anaerobic organisms, so one drug treats bacterial vaginosis and trichomoniasis, but only trichomoniasis partners are treated.
